lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Horizontal and vertical alignment of high-intensity circular local maxima forming a semi-regular grid on the lateral surface posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical high-luminance linear features intersecting with the primary blob clusters, creating anchor nodes in a rectangular coordinate arrangement.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Dominant horizontal feature on the upper flank exhibiting a high-contrast luminance step-down gradient from dorsal to ventral edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density cluster of high-intensity pixels within the bounds of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated near the trailing edge.
